name: Hue-Balls
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering of Tensor Fields
definition: A volume rendering technique that visualizes anisotropy by color-coding the deflection of a fixed input vector after tensor multiplication, mapped onto a sphere.
summary: Hue-Balls is a volume rendering technique that visualizes tensor anisotropy by color-coding vector deflection, distinguishing itself from methods like Lit-tensors by using direct hue mapping instead of illumination.
